label: /map — the 1858 lens is one fill, edge to edge, bars included
notes: Wil's screenshot of 2026-09-22 (19:39): the 1858 lens open on his iPhone, the live map showing undimmed behind the address bar and the toolbar while everything else sat under the lens's 70% black wash. Cause: the wash covered the UI layer's box, and the canvas runs T above and E below it (the runways, rounds 9 and 17); the bars are glass. His instruction: 'fully immersive … The background needs to be one fill color only. That stretches from edge to edge horizontally and vertically.' Ships: the lens shell covers the CANVAS's box (top -T, bottom -E) with one opaque fill, the page ground #1d1411; the runways come back as the shell's top and bottom padding so the plate, caption and door keep their exact geometry; the root carries `is-lens` while the lens is visible so Base.astro's edge sampler re-samples and <body> (hence the bars) takes the same colour; the Mapbox logo and (i) fade under the fill and return on close. allowedRoutes is empty: the lens is closed at rest (opacity 0), so no shot may drift. Numbered 27: rounds 23-26 (the chapter pages, /paintings) shipped on v2 from other sessions between the 18th and the 22nd, and this round was rebased onto their tip. Base 28cca65 = the v2 tip (round 26's commit, live); no base branch is pushed, the SHA is the revert point.
